name: altslerp (dim-selectable, colinear lerp)
plain: bleh's "slerp" blend mode. It runs on a chosen axis, treats near-colinear or zero vectors as lerp with threshold 0.9995, and keeps batch-of-t support. Code credits a gist by Birch-san. Only the setup part was read here.
math: normalise along dim; dot; if |dot|>0.9995 or NaN use lerp; else sine-weight formula on the original vectors (rest of function not read in full).
